heading: Liji 25 · Zhongni Yan Ju 仲尼燕居 · Kung-Nî At Home At Ease · Zhongni Yan Ju 9 … Zhongni Yan Ju 15

items.text: Follow behind your elders when walking and stand in your proper place relative to them.
items.quote: walkers follow one another, and those who stand observe a certain order

heading: Liji 25 · Zhongni Yan Ju 仲尼燕居 · Kung-Nî At Home At Ease · Zhongni Yan Ju 1 … Zhongni Yan Ju 8

items.text: Offer food to the dead to express loving feeling toward them.
items.quote: the ceremony of putting down food (by the deceased) serves to express the loving feeling towards those who are dead and for whom they are mourning
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead violate the first commandment (Ex 20:3-5).

items.text: Observe the proper periods of mourning and express the required sorrow.
items.quote: the different periods of mourning will have their proper expression of sorrow

items.text: In the home, maintain the proper distinction between juniors and elders.
items.quote: in the ordinary life at home, and there will be the (right) distinction between young and old

items.text: Maintain harmony among the three branches of the kin within the home.
items.quote: inside the door of the female apartments, and there will be harmony among the three branches of kin
